title: Asset Security learning paths

fast.method: Read each unit summary, draw the lifecycle, then complete recall checks.

standard.method: Study in sequence; after each unit explain the owner, control, lifecycle stage, and business reason in a fresh scenario.

reinforcement.method: Rebuild the lifecycle and classification decision from memory, then resolve the scenario seeds without notes.

completionEvidence: Can distinguish asset owner, custodian, and user
Can select handling and disposal controls from classification and risk
Can explain why retention is a business/legal decision rather than indefinite backup
